newsitem.title: CHINA: China central bank supervises overseas institutes.
newsitem.headline: China central bank supervises overseas institutes.

text.p: China's central bank has issued a circular calling for enhanced supervision of China-funded financial institutions overseas, the Xinhua news agency said.

Domestic investors in such institutions must set up a special department and assign sufficient manpower to be responsible for daily management of the institutions overseas, said the notice issued by the People's Bank of China.
The head management bodies of such institutions should improve their supervision, Xinhua quoted the notice as saying in an overnight report.
The head management bodies were required to send on time to the central bank statistical reports on their overseas financial institutions.

Increases or reductions in capital stock, reshuffling of stock structure, share right transfers, institutional upgrading, and withdrawals or mergers must be approved by the central bank, the notice said.
